meta.title: Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion on Invoice Mismatch: refused for a user without the AP Executive role
gaps: The invoice-mismatch Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion flow and its refusal or availability for a non-AP Executive user and an AP Executive user, including the required role-specific sign-ins and RBAC configuration check.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The invoice-mismatch Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion flow and its refusal or availability for a non-AP Executive user and an AP Executive user, including the required role-specific sign-ins and RBAC configuration check.

args.need: sign in as a user without the AP Executive role, attempt Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion on an invoice mismatch, then repeat as an AP Executive and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: The catalog cannot access invoices, create an invoice mismatch, invoke Credit/Debit Note Auto-Suggestion, or sign in as users with the two required role configurations.
Assert that the resulting screen has no crash or server error after the tester completes the role comparison.
